# Stirling — reference 3

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

First Stirling term for Gamma at r=abs(x)&gt;0: sqrt(2*pi)*r^(r-1/2)*exp(-r), evaluated in log space.
